claim: ADP's NER Pulse reported that, for the four weeks ending November 7, 2026, U.S. private employers added an average of 21,000 jobs per week. This is a timely private-sector employment indicator, not the BLS total nonfarm payroll first-print figure; it should be treated as contextual evidence only and not as a direct measurement of the market's +90,000 threshold.
quote: For the four weeks ending November 7, 2026, U.S. private employers added an average of 21,000 jobs per week, according to the NER Pulse
resolutionMapping: The market resolves on the BLS November 2026 first-print total nonfarm payroll change being at least +90,000. ADP NER Pulse is an independent, high-frequency private-sector payroll indicator and can inform the labour-market context before the BLS release, but it excludes public-sector employment, uses a four-week average ending November 7, is preliminary, and is not the BLS metric. It cannot alone establish whether the threshold is met.
verificationNote: User explicitly approved submission of this exact ADP NER Pulse evidence item after reviewing the claim, source, publication time, novelty boundary, and its limitation as contextual private-sector evidence rather than the BLS NFP measure.

claim: FIDE's official report states that Game 3 of the 2026 World Championship ended in a draw after 60 moves, leaving the match tied at 1½–1½ heading into the rest day on November 27, 2026. This establishes the verified cumulative score after three games; it does not establish or predict the score after Game 8.
quote: The third game of the Salesforce FIDE World Championship Match 2026 in Geneva ended in a draw after a 60-move battle. The match is tied at 1½–1½ heading into the rest day.
resolutionMapping: The market resolves on whether Javokhir Sindarov has strictly more cumulative match points than Gukesh after Game 8. FIDE's dated Game 3 report gives the official cumulative score after the first three games (1½–1½), a directly relevant interim value for the same match-points metric. It is only an interim score and must not be represented as the Game 8 result or as evidence that either player will lead after Game 8.
verificationNote: Standing owner authorization applies. Primary source is the official International Chess Federation report; exact publication timestamp and verbatim passage are checked against the archived snapshot by the validator.
